name: pari-strength-pressure-test
purpose: Stress-test every rewrite-slider value against dense meaning, uncertainty, relationships, and edit-discipline traps. These cases are intentionally harder than ordinary prose; they are not representative user text.

cases.input: The survey was open from May 3 through May 10. Of 43 invited staff, 31 submitted a response; 19 of those respondents supported the proposal and 12 opposed it. The results do not show what the 12 people who did not respond think, so they should not be described as a majority of all staff.
mustPreserve: no claim that a majority of all staff supports it
doNotInfer: treat respondents as all invited staff
turn 19 respondents into a majority of all staff
say the nonrespondents oppose or support the proposal
cases.editIntent: Paraphrase the dense counts naturally without blurring denominators or the final caution.

cases.input: The early measurements suggest that the patch may reduce startup time on older laptops, but the test did not include machines with encrypted disks. We therefore cannot say that it will speed up every supported device, and the team has not decided whether to ship it by default.
mustPreserve: evidence is early and only suggests a possible reduction
the tested group was older laptops
no guarantee for every supported device
doNotInfer: claim the patch definitely speeds up devices
say encrypted disks caused a problem
say the team decided to ship or reject it
cases.editIntent: Keep the qualifications while giving the paragraph fresher sentence framing.

cases.input: No complaints appeared in the support log during the first 48 hours. That is not evidence that nobody encountered the bug: the log records submitted tickets, not every failed attempt, and the monitoring job was offline for part of Tuesday.
mustPreserve: no complaints were logged in the first 48 hours
the log only contains submitted tickets
monitoring was offline for part of Tuesday
doNotInfer: claim the outage caused any particular failure
cases.editIntent: Make the distinction between no recorded reports and no actual failures unmistakable.

cases.input: If the archive is corrupt, restore the copy from Monday; if Monday's copy is also corrupt, stop and ask Priya before trying another source. Do not overwrite the current folder unless the restored copy has been checked against the manifest.
mustPreserve: Monday copy is the first restore option
if that copy is corrupt, stop and ask Priya
do not try another source before asking
do not overwrite current folder before manifest check
doNotInfer: reverse which copy is checked first
cases.editIntent: Rewrite the instructions clearly while preserving branch order and the safety condition.

cases.input: After the reminder was sent, late submissions fell from 14 to 9 in the next week. The sample was small, and two instructors also extended their deadlines, so the report says the reminder coincided with the decrease rather than caused it.
mustPreserve: the period was the following week
the report does not claim the reminder caused the decrease
doNotInfer: attribute the entire decrease to the reminder
cases.editIntent: Improve flow without strengthening the causal claim.

cases.input: On Monday, Elena sent the draft to Marcus for review. Before Marcus replied, Elena replaced the chart and sent a second version on Tuesday; Marcus's Wednesday comments refer to the first version, not the replacement.
mustPreserve: Elena sent the first draft Monday
Marcus had not replied before the replacement
Elena replaced the chart and sent a second version Tuesday
Marcus commented Wednesday on version one
doNotInfer: say the chart replacement came from Marcus
cases.editIntent: Make the sequence and version reference easier to follow.

cases.input: Rae told Jo that the draft might be ready after the second review, but the notes do not say whether Rae or Jo would perform that review. A later message says only, 'I can look again Friday,' so the reviewer is still unclear.
mustPreserve: readiness is tentative and after a second review
the notes do not identify who performs it
the later quote is exactly 'I can look again Friday,'
doNotInfer: assign the review to Rae or Jo
turn 'might be ready' into a promise
cases.editIntent: Improve the paragraph but deliberately leave unresolved details unresolved.

cases.input: Nina gave Omar the revised schedule after he asked for it, but she did not confirm whether the room had changed. The note says 'they will check before lunch'; it does not identify who 'they' refers to.
mustPreserve: Nina did not confirm a room change
the check is planned before lunch
doNotInfer: assign the room check to Nina or Omar
turn a planned check into a completed check
cases.editIntent: Clarify the two sentences without resolving ambiguous pronouns by guesswork.

cases.input: At 08:15 UTC on 2026-04-09, build 3.14.2 processed 1,204 records in 2.6 seconds; build 3.14.1 processed 1,240 in 2.9 seconds. The faster run used fewer records, so these figures alone do not establish a per-record speed improvement.
mustPreserve: the runs are not a fair per-record comparison
doNotInfer: swap either record count or runtime
cases.editIntent: Paraphrase technical reporting without changing any numeric relation.

cases.input: The invoice lists $1,280 for the annual plan and $96 for setup, before tax. The $96 setup fee is refundable only if cancellation occurs within 14 calendar days of payment; the annual charge is not refundable under that clause.
mustPreserve: only the setup fee may be refunded
refund requires cancellation within 14 calendar days of payment
the clause does not refund the annual charge
doNotInfer: apply the refund condition to the annual charge
change calendar days to business days
cases.editIntent: Make the exception easy to understand without broadening refund eligibility.

cases.input: The email says, 'Do not publish the draft until Maya approves the figures.' Maya approved the figures on Thursday, but the editor still has not confirmed whether the draft itself is ready to publish.
mustPreserve: figure approval does not establish draft readiness
editor has not confirmed publication readiness
doNotInfer: treat figure approval as final publication approval
cases.editIntent: Rewrite around the quotation while preserving the quoted language exactly.

cases.input: The client uses API v2.3.1 and retries a request only after a 503 response. It must not retry a 401, because the credential has to be refreshed first; the migration is still untested on iOS 17.6.
doNotInfer: say the migration works on iOS 17.6
cases.editIntent: Improve readability while retaining the exception logic and technical tokens.

cases.input: Before exporting, compare every label with the source table. If a value is missing, leave the cell blank; do not estimate it from neighboring rows. You may correct a spelling error in a label, but you may not change the underlying category.
mustPreserve: check every label against the source table before export
do not infer from neighboring rows
doNotInfer: remove the narrow permission to correct spelling
broaden spelling correction into category editing
cases.editIntent: Rephrase the procedure while preserving each permitted and prohibited action.

cases.input: The first review found no reproducible crash, but it did find a delay when the cache was cold. That delay does not explain the blank screen reported by two users, and the second review has not reproduced either report.
mustPreserve: first review did not reproduce a crash
delay is not established as cause of blank screen
doNotInfer: say the cold cache caused the blank screen
say no users saw a blank screen
omit the disagreement between reports and reproduction
cases.editIntent: Make contrasts clear without turning observations into an explanation.

cases.input: If the export had finished before the maintenance window, the team would have reviewed it on Tuesday. It finished afterward, so the Tuesday review did not happen; the team has not yet chosen a new date.
mustPreserve: Tuesday review was conditional on export finishing before maintenance
doNotInfer: say maintenance caused the late export
cases.editIntent: Retain the counterfactual and actual outcome as separate facts.

cases.input: The vendor changed the certificate on Friday, and the importer began rejecting the feed that afternoon. Restarting the importer restored new records but did not backfill the 37 missing entries; support has not determined whether those entries can be recovered.
mustPreserve: importer began rejecting feed that afternoon
37 records remain missing and were not backfilled
doNotInfer: claim the certificate change is proven cause
say all 37 records are permanently lost
claim the restart recovered old entries
cases.editIntent: Keep the chronology, partial recovery, and unresolved cause distinct.

cases.input: Not every reviewer objected to the wording: two requested a change, one asked for more evidence, and the other three left no comment. The record does not say that the silent reviewers agreed.
mustPreserve: silence is not evidence of agreement
doNotInfer: say the three silent reviewers approved
collapse requests for edits and evidence
cases.editIntent: Preserve the distinction among objection, evidence request, and silence.

cases.input: The incident note attributes 'the queue was empty' to the operator, while the dashboard captured a nonzero queue at 10:42. Neither record explains the mismatch, and the note does not say whether the operator was looking at the same region.
mustPreserve: quote is attributed to the operator
dashboard showed a nonzero queue at 10:42
doNotInfer: accuse either source of being wrong
assume both observed the same region
cases.editIntent: Make the evidence conflict readable without adjudicating it.

cases.input: Disconnect power before opening the enclosure. If the status light is still on, do not touch the board; wait 30 seconds and ask the lab lead to verify isolation. The manual says the light may remain on after disconnection, not that the board is safe to handle.
mustPreserve: if light remains on, do not touch the board
wait 30 seconds and ask lab lead to verify isolation
light state does not certify safe handling
doNotInfer: say the board is safe when the light is off
cases.editIntent: Improve clarity but treat every instruction and safety qualification as critical.

cases.input: Guests may view the public schedule without signing in. Editing requires an account, except that the coordinator can make a one-time correction for a guest who cannot access email; that exception does not grant the guest continuing edit access.
mustPreserve: guests can view schedule without login
coordinator may make one correction for guest unable to access email
one-time correction does not grant continuing access
cases.editIntent: Keep the default rule and its tightly bounded exception distinct.

cases.input: Tuesday: not the full export, just the 8-row sample. Mina said the headers match; didn't check the totals. Ask Theo before sending outside the team, unless he is out, then leave it in drafts.
mustPreserve: Tuesday note concerns an 8-row sample, not full export
if Theo is absent, leave draft unsent
doNotInfer: send externally when Theo is absent
turn the sample into the full export
cases.editIntent: Repair fragments into clear prose without adding a sender or claiming unchecked work is complete.

cases.input: The first file had the old address and I changed it before dispatch, but the copy in the shared folder still has the old address; Lena said not to overwrite it until she checks whether the signed version was already sent.
mustPreserve: speaker changed first file before dispatch
shared-folder copy still has old address
Lena said not to overwrite yet
signed version may already have been sent and needs checking
doNotInfer: assign Lena's instruction to someone else
cases.editIntent: Split the run-on into natural sentences while preserving which copy changed.

cases.input: The room was quiet, the instructions were clear, and I finished the form before lunch. I would use the same process again.
doNotInfer: invent a reason for the quiet room
cases.editIntent: This is already natural. High strength may rephrase it, but should not inflate tone or add detail; low strength should be able to leave it nearly unchanged.

cases.input: I know I missed the first message, and I am sorry about that. I still need the original receipt before I can approve the reimbursement; the screenshot is helpful, but it is not a substitute.
mustPreserve: original receipt is required for approval
doNotInfer: make the request harsher or more deferential
cases.editIntent: Refresh wording while preserving the speaker's accountable but firm voice.

cases.input: The package arrived with one corner crushed. I have not opened it, so I cannot tell whether the device is damaged; the seller's message says only that a replacement may be available after inspection.
mustPreserve: replacement is only a possibility after inspection
doNotInfer: say device is damaged or undamaged
cases.editIntent: Make the uncertainty concise without answering the unresolved question.

cases.input: The chart combines January figures from the billing export with February figures copied from an email. The email did not include refunds, while the export did; until the two sources use the same definition, the apparent month-to-month increase is not comparable.
mustPreserve: increase is not comparable until definitions align
doNotInfer: reverse which month came from which source
cases.editIntent: Clarify provenance and comparability, not just substitute vocabulary.

cases.input: The council approved a six-month trial of the evening route, not a permanent schedule change. Service will run on Thursdays only, except on holidays, and the stop at Pine Street remains unchanged. Staff will compare boarding counts with the same period last year, but because the route is new and the comparison uses a different fare system, the report will describe patterns rather than estimate how many riders switched from other routes.
mustPreserve: compare boarding counts with same period last year
report describes patterns and does not estimate rider switching
doNotInfer: say the comparison is fully equivalent
cases.editIntent: Reorganize this dense paragraph substantially if useful, without collapsing any exception or limitation.

cases.input: The study found that participants who used the checklist made fewer formatting errors, but it did not assign participants randomly. People who chose the checklist also reported more prior experience, which could explain some of the difference. The authors recommend testing the checklist in a randomized study; they do not conclude that it improves comprehension or reduces factual mistakes.
mustPreserve: checklist users made fewer formatting errors
checklist users reported more prior experience
no conclusion about comprehension or factual mistakes
doNotInfer: claim the checklist caused fewer errors
cases.editIntent: Preserve the exact outcome measured and the study's causal limits.

cases.input: If the signed form reaches Finance by 3 p.m. on Friday, payment can be included in the Monday batch; forms received later move to the next batch, unless Finance requests a correction, in which case the processing date is reset after the corrected form arrives. The coordinator can confirm receipt but cannot promise the payment date.
mustPreserve: on-time form may enter Monday batch
later forms move to next batch
correction resets processing date after corrected form arrives
coordinator can confirm receipt but not promise payment date
doNotInfer: apply the correction rule before a correction is requested
cases.editIntent: Make the decision tree easier to read without changing its branches.

cases.input: The release note says the migration 'preserves existing folder names.' In testing, 6 of 80 folders changed names when they contained a trailing space; the team has not established whether those names are valid inputs or whether the migration is at fault. The release note has not been updated, and support is asking users to keep a backup rather than promising that every folder is unaffected.
mustPreserve: 6 of 80 folders changed names when trailing spaces were present
validity of inputs and responsibility are unresolved
support recommends backup and makes no universal promise
cases.editIntent: Retain the mismatch between broad release wording and qualified test evidence.

cases.input: I asked for a shorter introduction so readers could reach the example sooner, not because the background was inaccurate. We removed one repeated explanation and moved the date to the first paragraph; the source note and the qualification 'in the two locations tested' stayed in place. The revision is intended to improve navigation, and it should not be presented as stronger evidence for the claim.
mustPreserve: shorter introduction was for navigation, not factual correction
qualification 'in the two locations tested' retained
cases.editIntent: Preserve both the reason for editing and the limits on what the edit proves.
